description: Like defk-sgw.3 and defk-dig, but the fresh session may read only the built HexDocs (doc/ HTML or the epub), not the repo: install defk in a new project, write and test a kernel, find out from the scope page whether a given job fits, read a compile error and follow its link, and answer 'should I use defk or Elixir here?' for two example jobs. Record every confusing point; fix or ticket each. Append the log next to the other cold tests.
